name: Vercel
description: Manage and inspect Vercel projects/deployments — list projects, trigger and check deployments, read build/runtime logs, and manage environment variables. Requires a Vercel personal access token (Settings → Connectors → Vercel, or env var CONNECTOR_VERCEL_KEY).

actions.name: vercel_list_projects
actions.description: List Vercel projects in the account/team, with their latest production URL and framework.

actions.name: vercel_list_deployments
actions.description: List recent deployments, optionally filtered to one project. Returns state (READY/ERROR/BUILDING), URL, and creation time.

projectId.description: Vercel project ID or name to filter by

actions.name: vercel_get_deployment
actions.description: Get full details/status for a single deployment by its ID or URL.

actions.name: vercel_create_deployment
actions.description: Trigger a new deployment for a project from its connected Git repo (deploys the latest commit on the given branch/ref). Use this to redeploy after Meiko pushes code changes.

actions.name: vercel_list_env_vars
actions.description: List (non-secret metadata for) environment variables configured on a project.

actions.name: vercel_set_env_var
actions.description: Create or update an environment variable on a project (e.g. to wire up a new API key after Vibe Coding deploys a generated app).
